title: Credit Card Four-Key USB Macro Pad

via.rationale: Board-wide autorouted via geometry is the ordinary 0.6/0.3 mm profile. The only 0.4/0.3 mm feature is the explicit source-owned J1_GND_ESCAPE_VIA below.

GND.rationale: Two-layer return plane for USB power, display, keys, and analog audio.

escape.rationale: J1 is a 0.5 mm-pitch FPC connector. Pin 2 needs a short dogbone escape at the declared 0.15 mm manufacturing clearance before it reaches the GND planes.

VBUS.rationale: USB 5 V from the XIAO module and LCD backlight supply.

V3V3.rationale: Low-current XIAO 3.3 V auxiliary rail. Net-wide 0.30 mm routing is required by J1's 0.30 mm pad on 0.50 mm pitch and is electrically ample for the LCD logic and microphone chain.

LCD_MOSI.rationale: Short, board-local ST7789P3 SPI data trace; no controlled-impedance requirement in this revision.

LCD_SCK.rationale: Short, board-local ST7789P3 SPI clock; keep away from the microphone block and route over continuous ground.

LCD_LEDA.rationale: Resistor-limited LCD backlight current is below 120 mA; ordinary 0.5 mm power routing is sufficient for this short run.

MIC_RAW.rationale: A 2.96 mm local analog link from C6 to the 0.60 mm MIC1 pad. The 0.20/0.15 mm manufacturing-floor geometry is required to escape between the microphone body and board edge; current is negligible and the route is fully board-local.

MIC_AC.rationale: AC-coupled microphone signal biased at VBIAS.

VBIAS.rationale: Filtered 1.65 V virtual ground for the preamplifier.

MIC_FB.rationale: TLV9061 feedback node; minimize loop area.

MIC_AMP.rationale: Amplified microphone signal before anti-alias resistor.

MIC_ADC.rationale: Filtered ADC input to XIAO D8.

stitchingVias.name: J1_GND_ESCAPE_VIA
stitchingVias.rationale: Targeted ordinary 0.6/0.3 mm GND via 3.05 mm inboard of J1 pin 2. The offset clears adjacent 0.5 mm-pitch signal escapes while the source-owned GND pour provides the short same-net neck from pad 2 to the via and continuous top-side GND copper.

keepouts.name: U1_ANTENNA_COPPER_KEEPOUT
keepouts.rationale: Matches the source-owned U1_ANTENNA_RELIEF interior slot. The relief removes carrier FR-4 and both copper layers under the antenna center while stopping short of the castellated end-pad rows and routed signal escape corridor.
